title: DeForest Buckner: Colts didn't play up to our standards, whatsoever

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DeForest Buckner: Colts didn't play up to our standards, whatsoever
sources.description: The Colts' defense gave up 304 passing yards and 202 rushing yards in their Week 1 loss to the Ravens, and Colts defensive tackle DeForest Buckner says it was unacceptable.
